title: DevProof bundle lock
description: A lock records the immutable resolution of one manifest. It is generated, never hand-written, and it is what makes a build reproducible: a locked build fails rather than quietly accepting material that has changed (DP-004). The document is canonical JSON (RFC 8785) and has nowhere to record a timestamp, hostname, user, registry destination, or credential -- a lock is committed to a repository, so anything it can hold is something that leaks.

manifestDigest.description: Binds this lock to one manifest, computed over the manifest's normalized typed model rather than its bytes, so YAML spelling, comments, and key order do not affect it. A manifest edit that changes meaning invalidates the lock.

sources.description: Sorted by name, so the order resolvers finished in -- which is concurrency-dependent -- cannot reach the lock digest (DP-012).

files.description: Sorted by canonical path bytes, strictly increasing.

treeDigest.description: The canonical payload identity this lock commits to.

digest.description: Format v1 accepts SHA-256 only, in lowercase hexadecimal. The algorithm is explicit so a digest cannot be interpreted under the wrong one.

format.description: The bundle format this lock was produced for. Readers dispatch on it and reject what they do not recognize rather than guessing.

mode.description: Normalized file mode, decimal: 420 is 0644 and 493 is 0755. A regular file with any execute bit set becomes 0755; every other regular file becomes 0644. Setuid, setgid, sticky, and read/write variations are not preserved (DP-005).

resolver.description: The implementation and version that produced this resolution, so a resolver whose behavior changed cannot silently satisfy a lock made by an earlier one.

requested.description: What the manifest asked for, which may be mutable.

resolved.description: What it resolved to, which must not be.

treeDigest.description: This source's filtered contribution before its mount path is applied. It is the common identity across source types: a Git commit and a local directory holding the same files have the same value here.

resolverVersion.description: The resolver implementation's version. A resolver whose behaviour changed cannot silently satisfy a lock an earlier one made, and its name does not change when its behaviour does.

path.description: Final canonical path in the bundle.

source.description: The single owner of this path. Every final path has exactly one (DP-011), and the named source must appear in this lock's sources.

sourcePath.description: Path within the source, before the mount path is applied.
